terms.label: suite-exact, v{suite_version}
terms.plain: Matched the named Excel oracle bit-for-bit for every one of the {vector_count} inputs in suite {suite_version} under the stated observation context.
terms.boundary: Inputs outside this suite are not covered by this claim.

terms.label: characterized bit-exact
terms.plain: Claims bitwise agreement with Excel over the declared input domain using the recorded mechanism and observation context.
terms.boundary: The claim does not extend beyond its declared domain, Excel build, workbook mode, locale, or platform scope.

terms.label: reference engine: available
terms.plain: The current OxFunc projection admits this entry to its implementation surface.
terms.boundary: This does not by itself mean the Handbook page is curated or that an implementation has passed a published suite.

terms.label: Handbook depth: projected
terms.plain: The page currently contains mechanically projected metadata rather than a fully curated Handbook treatment.
terms.boundary: Missing curation is shown explicitly; projected fields retain their upstream provenance and limitations.

terms.label: current baseline
terms.plain: The default public view evaluated under the pinned Excel observation baseline named by this answer.
terms.boundary: Current is a named, inspectable view rather than a timeless or automatically advancing fact.

terms.label: stale
terms.plain: A dependency or sensitivity-frontier input changed after this answer was produced.
terms.boundary: Stale is an invitation to re-evaluate; it is not automatically a defeat or proof that the value is wrong.

terms.label: contested
terms.plain: The current policy does not license one unique answer from the credible alternatives on record.
terms.boundary: The alternatives and the point at which resolution stopped remain visible.
